plan.problem: The town already lights mapped exterior buildings, but its noon contact shadows can fall inside opaque artwork. The leisure center and ordinary outdoor furnishings have no corresponding integrated trial.
plan.currentContract: #944 keeps indoor scenery in its original palette. The prior shared renderer supplies a ten-percent noon contact and no noon solar projection for the mapped exteriors. The ground pass precedes all footY actors, clips to map bounds and uses bounded phase/version caching.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The existing six mapped assets omit floor-standing displays and street furniture. Current footY is for sorting and includes source padding, so it is insufficient alone to anchor a visible shadow.
plan.design: Compare existing noon against a subtle opt-in preview on the same normal walking viewport. Place a few logical pixels of shadow at the measured foot. Use the established ground pass and footprint geometry; keep the indoor light without an outdoor solar cast and scope data to grounded items. Avoid stacked shading on pre-painted dark edges.
alternativesRejected: Darken entire room or recolor the actor
Global long shadows, blur, or fake lights at noon
Replace the common renderer or edit the art files
plan.migration: Query-only opt-in. Scene transitions preserve the same in-memory lighting phase; no saved settings.
plan.compatibility: Original town when disabled, outside allowed scenes and phases, or if modules are absent. Preserve the renderer ABI and existing letterbox, snapped draws and ground-before-sprite ordering.
boundaryCases: Existing noon contact on exterior buildings, baked source shadows, multiple feet/opaque bases, already-dark floors, plants and wall/airborne drafts
